messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER — spike of 502/504s observed from api-gateway in us-west-2. Error rate 502s at 18% for the last 3m. Triggering on-call. https://kibana.redwood.example/alerts/3700001111
PagerDuty: Paging AlexW (on-call). Please acknowledge.
AlexW: acked — I'm in. Anyone see a recent deploy?
PriyaS: not from product side, no deploys in last 40m. I can see a big jump in upstream 502s coming from the auth-service cluster.
MarcL: I'm seeing a fanout at the edge: nginx -> gateway-proxy returning 502s, upstream connection reset. p95 latency also up ~300ms.
SaraOps: autoscaling metrics look normal. CPU/GPU not saturated. Connection errors to auth-db latency spikes in the same window.
JunM: tailing gateway logs now — a lot of `upstream prematurely closed connection` and a few TLS handshake timeouts to auth-service.
AlexW: ok let's isolate blast radius. Priya, can you flip routing for api-gateway pool B -> fallback pool A (reduce traffic to pool B by 80%)? Marc, can you set proxy-retry to 3 and lower maxconn on nginx?
PriyaS: yep doing weighted routing change via infra console -> updating weights to 20/80 now.
MarcL: nginx config hot patch: `proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502; proxy_connect_timeout 1s; proxy_read_timeout 30s;` Applying to gateway-proxy.
SaraOps: scaled gateway-proxy replicas +3 (k8s: `kubectl scale deploy/gateway-proxy --replicas=12 -n infra`).
JunM: temporary mitigation looks promising — 502 rate dropped to 6% after weight change and scaling. Correlated with fewer TLS timeouts too.
EmmaCS: customer-impact check: CS dashboard shows 9 distinct customers saw failed API calls in last 10m, two enterprise tenants reported degraded UX. Filing incident channel for status page.
AlexW: good. Can someone draft short status page update? Keep it generic: "API errors causing intermittent 5xx for small % of requests in US region; mitigation in progress."
EmmaCS: Posting update to status.redwood: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for API requests in US-West region. Mitigation in progress; some customers may see intermittent failures. Next update in 30 minutes."
MarcL: root cause hypotheses: recent TLS library bump on auth-service (rolled out last week) + transient DNS flaps to auth-db during backup window. Logs show `socket hang up` from auth-service instances.
PriyaS: rolling back last cert/lib change on one auth-service cluster to validate — will coordinate with release manager.
JunM: dekker: added temporary circuit breaker on gateway to avoid cascading failures: `env GATEWAY_CB_THRESHOLD=0.3` and reduced concurrent upstreams for auth-service.
AlexW: status: 502s stabilized ~2-3% after mitigations. We'll keep routing bias and replicas until root cause confirmed. Handing off to eng-sre for follow-up postmortem.
SaraOps: creating follow-up ticket (ENGSRE-4129) with logs + timeline + perf graphs.
EmmaCS: Notified affected customers via queued email and support threads; two enterprise contacts requested ETA — told them 60m and we'll follow up.
PagerDuty: on-call escalation cleared. AlexW on-call session ended at 3700001275.
IncidentBot: Incident resolved (mitigated) — keep watching for 60m.
AlexW: thanks team — great coordination. Postmortem owners: MarcL (technical RCA), PriyaS (deploy/rollback actions), EmmaCS (customer comms). We'll sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
